name: repository-agent-exposure
description: Credential-free candidate installation and real repository-policy CLI admission without an authoring session.
validates: The candidate stamps and provisions its standalone Worktrees runtime with the policy library.
The installed CLI returns complete versioned policy answers without adopting the repository.
Fresh repository denial defeats review-purpose labels without interpreting review instructions as permission.
Malformed policy refuses visibly; adoption refusal has no project-registration effects.
A denied source-only repository registers without agent exposure and allocates a real Git worktree without a launch or project adoption.

config.CR_HARNESS_MOUNT: read-only local candidate checkout supplied with --harness-mount
